target_structure: Separate scalar candidate per integrated target; all exact formal hard-master/Gamma/exponent channels belonging to that target fitted jointly. No cross-target common annihilator.
family_selection: only if no_candidate_within_fixed_shapes: recurrence training-only second
ambiguity_or_zero_prefix: Explicit stop/no candidate for that target; no forced nullspace choice or zero certificate
after_holdout: No refit, shape expansion or family change for this dataset
freeze: All target candidates and no-candidate outcomes, training bindings and SHA256/BLAKE3 frozen before any holdout opens
recurrence_conversion: Keep exact startup forcing B(t); apply beta conjugation to restore each physical channel. No automatic homogeneous full-integral ODE assertion. A later certified block companion may preserve inhomogeneous startup states.
